import Recaman.ThreeNonsuppliedData

set_option maxRecDepth 100000

namespace Recaman.FourNonsuppliedData

open Recaman.LeadingRunSupply
open Recaman.ThreeNonsuppliedData (wordArea localSupply oldSignature)

abbrev State := Recaman.ThreeNonsuppliedData.State

def trim (w : List Bool) : List Bool := w.drop (w.length-19)

def gap (s : State) (j : Nat) : State :=
  let ns := min 19 (s.subtractions+j)
  ⟨if ns=19 then trim (s.word++List.replicate j false)
     else s.word++List.replicate j false,
   s.additions, ns, s.nonsupplied⟩

def stepS (s : State) : State := gap s 1

def stepA (s : State) (e : Bool) : Option State :=
  let an := s.nonsupplied+(if e then 0 else 1)
  let admitted := if e then localSupply s.word ||
    (decide (s.subtractions<19) && oldSignature s.word) else !localSupply s.word
  if admitted && decide (an≤4) &&
      decide (s.subtractions=19 ∨ 1≤(s.subtractions : Int)-(s.additions+1 : Nat)+an) then
    some ⟨if s.subtractions=19 then trim (s.word++[true]) else s.word++[true],
      s.additions+1,s.subtractions,an⟩ else none

def macroA (s : State) (j : Nat) (e : Bool) : Option State := stepA (gap s j) e

theorem trim_append_letter (w : List Bool) (c : Bool) :
    trim (trim w++[c])=trim (w++[c]) := by
  unfold trim
  by_cases hlen : w.length≤19
  · simp [show w.length-19=0 by omega]
  · have hw : 19<w.length := by omega
    simp only [List.length_append,List.length_drop,List.length_singleton]
    rw [show w.length-(w.length-19)+1-19=1 by omega,
      List.drop_append_of_le_length (by simp only [List.length_drop]; omega),List.drop_drop,
      List.drop_append_of_le_length (by omega)]
    congr 2
    omega

theorem trim_idempotent (w : List Bool) : trim (trim w)=trim w := by
  simp only [trim,List.length_drop,List.drop_drop]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem trim_append_congr (v : List Bool) : ∀ u w : List Bool,
    trim u=trim w → trim (u++v)=trim (w++v) := by
  induction v with
  | nil => intro u w h; simpa using h
  | cons c v ih =>
    intro u w h
    have hnext : trim (u++[c])=trim (w++[c]) := by
      calc
        trim (u++[c])=trim (trim u++[c]) := (trim_append_letter u c).symm
        _=trim (trim w++[c]) := by rw [h]
        _=trim (w++[c]) := trim_append_letter w c
    simpa only [List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using ih (u++[c]) (w++[c]) hnext

theorem trim_append (w v : List Bool) : trim (trim w++v)=trim (w++v) := by
  exact trim_append_congr v (trim w) w (trim_idempotent w)

theorem trim_S_gap (w : List Bool) (j : Nat) (hj : 19≤j) :
    trim (w++List.replicate j false)=List.replicate 19 false := by
  unfold trim
  rw [List.length_append,List.length_replicate,List.drop_append]
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]
  simp only [List.nil_append,List.drop_replicate]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem gap_large (s : State) (j : Nat) (hj : 19≤j) :
    gap s j=⟨List.replicate 19 false,s.additions,19,s.nonsupplied⟩ := by
  have hmin : min 19 (s.subtractions+j)=19 := by omega
  simp [gap,hmin,trim_S_gap _ _ hj]

theorem gap_clamp (s : State) (j : Nat) : gap s j=gap s (min j 19) := by
  by_cases hj : j≤19
  · rw [Nat.min_eq_left hj]
  · rw [gap_large s j (by omega),Nat.min_eq_right (by omega),gap_large s 19 (by omega)]

theorem gap_add (s : State) (j k : Nat) : gap (gap s j) k=gap s (j+k) := by
  have hmin : min 19 (min 19 (s.subtractions+j)+k)=min 19 (s.subtractions+(j+k)) := by omega
  by_cases hfirst : min 19 (s.subtractions+j)=19
  · have hlast : min 19 (s.subtractions+(j+k))=19 := by omega
    have hsat : min 19 (19+k)=19 := by omega
    simp only [gap,hfirst,if_true,hlast,hsat]
    rw [trim_append,List.append_assoc,List.replicate_append_replicate]
  · by_cases hlast : min 19 (s.subtractions+(j+k))=19
    · simp only [gap,hfirst,if_false,hmin,hlast,if_true]
      rw [List.append_assoc,List.replicate_append_replicate]
    · simp only [gap,hfirst,if_false,hmin,hlast]
      rw [List.append_assoc,List.replicate_append_replicate]

-- Long S gaps retain a legal nonsupplied A. No A upper bound is encoded in stepA.
example : (macroA ⟨[],0,0,0⟩ 19 false).map (fun s => s.additions)=some 1 := by decide
example : (macroA ⟨[],10,0,3⟩ 20 false).map (fun s => s.additions)=some 11 := by decide
example : macroA ⟨[],0,0,0⟩ 0 false=none := by decide




def endpointWords : List (List Bool) :=
  Recaman.ThreeNonsuppliedData.endpointWords ++
  [[false,true,true,false,true,true,true],
   [false,true,false,true,true,true,true],
   [false,true,false,true,true,false,true,true,true],
   [false,false,true,true,true,true,true],
   [false,false,true,true,true,true,false,true,true],
   [false,false,true,true,true,false,true,true,true],
   [false,false,false,true,true,true,true,false,true,true,true],
   [false,false,false,false,true,true,true,true,false,true,true,true,true]]

def endpointGood (s : State) : Bool :=
  decide (((s.subtractions : Int)-(s.additions : Int)+(s.nonsupplied : Int)=1) → s.word ∈ endpointWords)

def goodState (s : State) : Bool :=
  decide (s.additions≤10 ∧ s.subtractions≤19 ∧ s.nonsupplied≤4 ∧ gap s 0=s) &&
    (List.range 20).all (fun j => endpointGood (gap s j))

abbrev Row := Nat × Nat

structure Table where
  size : Nat
  get : Nat → Row

def unpack (code : Nat) : State :=
  ⟨Recaman.ThreeNonsuppliedData.decodeWord 29 (code/4096),code%16,(code/16)%32,(code/512)%8⟩

def stateAt (rs : Table) (i : Nat) : State := unpack (rs.get i).1

def edgeAt (row : Row) (edge : Nat) : Nat := (row.2 >>> (14*edge)) % 16384

def checkOption (rs : Table) (s : Option State) (j : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s with
  | none => decide (j=0)
  | some t => decide (0<j ∧ j-1<rs.size ∧ stateAt rs (j-1)=t)

def checkOne (rs : Table) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  let row := rs.get i
  let s := stateAt rs i
  [goodState s,(List.range 20).all (fun j =>
    checkOption rs (macroA s j false) (edgeAt row (2*j)) &&
    checkOption rs (macroA s j true) (edgeAt row (2*j+1)))].all id

def verified (rs : Table) : Bool := (List.range rs.size).all (checkOne rs)

def verifiedRange (rs : Table) (lo count : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range count).all fun j => checkOne rs (lo+j)

def Member (rs : Table) (s : State) : Prop := ∃ i, i<rs.size ∧ stateAt rs i=s

def Covered (rs : Table) (s : State) : Prop := ∃ t j, Member rs t ∧ gap t j=s

theorem verifiedRange_at (rs : Table) (lo count : Nat) (h : verifiedRange rs lo count=true)
    (i : Nat) (hlo : lo≤i) (hhi : i<lo+count) : checkOne rs i=true := by
  have ht := List.all_eq_true.mp h (i-lo) (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hlo] at ht

theorem row_checked (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (i : Nat) (hi : i<rs.size) :
    checkOne rs i=true := List.all_eq_true.mp h i (List.mem_range.mpr hi)

theorem member_good (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s : State) (hs : Member rs s) :
    goodState s=true := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := hs
  have hr := row_checked rs h i hi
  simp only [checkOne,List.all_cons,List.all_nil,id_eq,Bool.and_true,Bool.and_eq_true] at hr
  exact hr.1

theorem member_additions_le_ten (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s : State) (hs : Member rs s) :
    s.additions≤10 := by
  have hg := member_good rs h s hs
  simp only [goodState,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq] at hg
  exact hg.1.1

theorem member_covered (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s : State) (hs : Member rs s) :
    Covered rs s := by
  have hg := member_good rs h s hs
  simp only [goodState,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq] at hg
  exact ⟨s,0,hs,hg.1.2.2.2⟩

theorem member_macroA (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s t : State)
    (hs : Member rs s) (j : Nat) (hj : j<20) (e : Bool) (ht : macroA s j e=some t) : Member rs t := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := hs
  have hr := row_checked rs h i hi
  simp only [checkOne,List.all_cons,List.all_nil,id_eq,Bool.and_true,Bool.and_eq_true] at hr
  have hc := List.all_eq_true.mp hr.2 j (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hc
  have he : checkOption rs (macroA (stateAt rs i) j e)
      (edgeAt (rs.get i) (2*j+(if e then 1 else 0)))=true := by
    cases e
    · simpa using hc.1
    · simpa using hc.2
  rw [ht] at he
  have hh := of_decide_eq_true he
  exact ⟨_,hh.2.1,hh.2.2⟩

theorem covered_additions_le_ten (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s : State) (hs : Covered rs s) :
    s.additions≤10 := by
  obtain ⟨t,j,hm,rfl⟩ := hs
  exact member_additions_le_ten rs h t hm

theorem covered_stepS (rs : Table) (s : State) (hs : Covered rs s) : Covered rs (stepS s) := by
  obtain ⟨t,j,hm,rfl⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨t,j+1,hm,(gap_add t j 1).symm⟩

theorem covered_stepA (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s t : State)
    (hs : Covered rs s) (e : Bool) (ht : stepA s e=some t) : Covered rs t := by
  obtain ⟨u,j,hm,hgap⟩ := hs
  have hmstep : macroA u (min j 19) e=some t := by
    unfold macroA
    rw [←gap_clamp,hgap]
    exact ht
  exact member_covered rs h t (member_macroA rs h u t hm (min j 19) (by omega) e hmstep)

theorem covered_endpoint_word (rs : Table) (h : verified rs=true) (s : State)
    (hs : Covered rs s)
    (hd : (s.subtractions : Int)-(s.additions : Int)+(s.nonsupplied : Int)=1) : s.word ∈ endpointWords := by
  obtain ⟨t,j,hm,rfl⟩ := hs
  have hg := member_good rs h t hm
  simp only [goodState,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq] at hg
  have hj : min j 19<20 := by omega
  have hc := List.all_eq_true.mp hg.2 (min j 19) (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
  have hp := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [←gap_clamp] at hp
  exact hp hd
